title: Mastering Motion and Micro-animations
summary: How micro-animations improve user retention, visual flow, and how to create natural gestures using the new Motion library.
content:
Visual feedback guides the user's focus. However, animations must feel natural. The `motion` library (formerly Framer Motion) provides a highly performant declarative physics-based spring engine.

### Dynamic Lists
Animating standard list reordering or entry transitions can be accomplished using `layout` and `<AnimatePresence>`:

```tsx
<motion.div layout>
  {filteredItems.map(item => (
    <motion.div key={item.id} layout />
  ))}
</motion.div>
```

Using spring animations ensures that interrupts look fluid, preventing jarring layout shifts.
